english_classification.chapter_title: The Chapter of the Elements that wept
english_classification.chapter_note: The oldest teaching layer is dominant. Paragraphs 2-7 form a complete, self-contained four-fold cosmological teaching about the weeping of the light elements (garments/sons of the First Man) at four stages of the cosmic drama. The enumeration structure (first, second, third, fourth) is systematic and internally complete. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system: cosmic beings weep at cosmic events. The teaching cycle closes naturally at P7 with the explanation of why the fourth weeping is worst. P8 then bridges to apostolic mission with 'Therefore, due to' — a classic editorial seam extending the completed teaching to justify apostolic suffering. P9 is a brief closing exhortation. No editorial bridge or institutional vocabulary intrudes into the core teaching sequence. No NT citations detected. Negative editorial fatigue score (-0.52) is consistent with the editorial material being brief and confined to the end.
